# ================== CELL 1: Load Pre‑quantized Model (GPTQ, 4‑bit, <20GB disk) ==================
!pip install -q fastapi uvicorn transformers torch accelerate auto-gptq pyngrok nest-asyncio


import torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM


model_name = "ramblingpolymath/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-W4A16"


print(f"Loading {model_name} (pre‑quantized GPTQ, disk ≈17.4 GB, mem ≈16 GB)…")


tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name, trust_remote_code=True)
if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
    tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token


# GPTQ models are loaded directly – no BitsAndBytesConfig needed
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    model_name,
    device_map="balanced",      # splits layers evenly across both T4s
    trust_remote_code=True,
    torch_dtype=torch.float16,  # activations stay fp16
    use_cache=True
)
model.eval()


print("✅ Model loaded successfully, sharded across 2×T4")

# ================== CELL 3: Server & ngrok (simple) ==================
import uvicorn
import threading
import time
from pyngrok import ngrok


# -------- Set your ngrok token directly (paste your authtoken here) --------
NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN = "3AI9OWDE3aXoIvlRbBIICBlo4Ur_7uVYv7Bp193sPiarvYLp6"   # <-- replace this string


if not NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN or NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN.startswith("YOUR_"):
    raise RuntimeError("Please set your real ngrok authtoken in the variable above.")


ngrok.set_auth_token(NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN)


# -------- Launch FastAPI in background thread --------
def run():
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000, log_level="info")


server_thread = threading.Thread(target=run, daemon=True)
server_thread.start()
time.sleep(2)   # let the server start


# -------- Expose via ngrok --------
try:
    public_url = ngrok.connect(8000).public_url
    print(f"\n✅ Server live at: {public_url}/generate")
    print(f"   Health check:    {public_url}/health")
    print(f"   Stop stream:     {public_url}/stop?session_id=<id>")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"ngrok error: {e}")
    ngrok.kill()
    raise


# Keep the notebook alive
try:
    while True:
        time.sleep(1)
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    print("\n🛑 Shutting down...")
    ngrok.kill()
